blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A tropical storm has entered the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) and has been assigned the local name “Queenie” as of 7 a.m. Thursday, September 24. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), in its daily forecast, said the storm would be less likely to make landfall in the country as it continues to move toward southern Japan. The weather system also had a low chance of enhancing the southwest monsoon, or habagat, the weather bureau said.
